description: Off-road vehicle map is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Local Government, Sport and Cultural Industries. This map is designed to show permitted and prohibited off-road vehicle areas in Western Australia and their licencing and usage requirements. These areas are governed by the Control of Vehicles (Off-road Vehicles) Act 1978. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Local Government, Sport and Cultural Industries. Its tags are off-road, trailbike. It offers 1 resource(s) in JSON. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
